property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always successfully calls the target contract with the selector for transferFrom(...) and thus returns/does not revert; the mutant that uses a different selector can cause the low-level call to fail (revert) for some callee, making transfer revert for some inputs.
change_summary: Change bytes4 selector to a different signature so the external call likely fails and causes revert inside the loop.
